record.challengeId: stable challenge UUID / instance id used as replay seed anchor
record.experienceMode: challenge | simulationLab; separates game-facing high-score records from benchmark/experiment records
record.leaderboardScope: challenge | simulationLab; default leaderboard namespace used for filtering and ranking
record.missionMode: optional Challenge Mode objective preset id preserved with records and attempts
record.scenarioFingerprint: stable grouping fingerprint derived from challengeId/replaySeedAnchor, generator version, mission mode, generation config, current/sample field config, hazard/terrain config, and duration
record.routeSource: per-attempt source: manual | greedyPlanner | externalSolver | importedPlan | savedReplay | unknown
record.solverId: optional external solver id for imported/external-solver attempts
record.solverLabel: optional display label for imported/external-solver attempts
record.fairness: per-attempt metadata: usesForecast, usesTruth, usesOracle, and fairForLeaderboard. Oracle/truth-assisted attempts are stored but labeled.
record.replaySeedAnchor: UUID seed anchor for deterministic regeneration
record.generationConfig: config snapshot used with UUID seed anchor
record.replaySeedContract: challengeId, replaySeedAnchor, generationVersion, generationConfig, and derivedSeeds
record.exactReplay: availability, method, and reason for snapshot or deterministic regeneration replay
record.missionOptions: run options such as ignoreUpdateEvents so continuous-run attempts are visible
record.attempts: attempt list with score, label, plan, result, summary, pathSummary, timestamps
record.pathSummary: per-attempt waypoint count, sample count, stars captured, energy, hazards, elapsed time, route-quality highlights when present, and actual path availability

notes: Leaderboard exports are local-browser save artifacts for sharing saved challenges and attempts. Challenge Mode and Simulation Lab share storage infrastructure but are filtered by experienceMode/leaderboardScope. They are importable and merge into localStorage.
